data.title: Pat Bradley: A lovely swing to remember
data.description: The swing that God gave Pat Bradley was a thing of beauty. It was a lovely rhythmic motion that never seemed to change, whatever club she was using. I found her practising at the Florida club she called home at the time. After a while, she spotted me watching her go through her practice routine and said hello, she caught my English accent and asked me many questions. I had always wanted to meet her as I had admired her swing ever since I saw it on TV.

data.title: Bangkok condos squeezed by floods, weak demand and 65,300-unit glut
data.description: Bangkok’s condo market faces weak purchasing power, flooding and more than 65,300 unsold units worth THB370 billion.

data.title: Highlights of the IMF-World Bank Meeting, Oct 14, 2026: Launch of "Bangkok Blueprint" to Combat Global Financial Fraud
data.description: Annual Meetings of the IMF and World Bank Group, Oct 14, 2026: "Ekniti-Vitai" take the IMF stage to launch "Bangkok Blueprint" to combat global financial fraud - Watch the Fiscal Monitor warning global public debt reaching 100% of GDP, while "Ajay Banga" leads discussion on unlocking emerging market investment.

data.title: Atletico sink Man Utd as Viking deny Bayern in Champions League
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Atletico Madrid beat Manchester United 2-0 in the UEFA Champions League on Tuesday as the Red Devils continued their poor run, while Bayern Munich were held 3-3 in Norway by underdogs Viking Stavanger.

data.title: Young Om gives Thailand Olympic boost
data.description: Putthaphum Nakpaen has emerged as the best U23 BMX racer in Asia after a breakthrough World Cup campaign in China, giving Thailand a significant boost in its bid to qualify for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

data.title: Rangsan's Chonburi stint ends after 4 losses in row
data.description: Chonburi have parted company with head coach Rangsan Viwatchaichok and his assistant, Sinthaweechai Hathairattanakool, after a winless run of four Thai League 1 games this season.

data.title: Easy win for mixed duo as Ratchanok pulls out injured
data.description: Mixed doubles pair Dechapol Puavaranukroh and Supissara Paewsampran advanced to the second round of the US$950,000 Denmark Open in Odense on Tuesday.

data.title: Scam crackdowns net 39 suspects
data.description: Police arrested 39 suspects and seized assets worth more than 500 million baht in raids across 11 provinces targeting a transnational scam and money-laundering network.

data.title: Unsit rejects 'shame' jibe over exams
data.description: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat on Tuesday defended the ministry's handling of alleged fraud in local recruitment exams, hitting back at criticism from his predecessor.

data.title: Raid frees exploited Myanmar children
data.description: Authorities have arrested four suspects and rescued children from Myanmar allegedly forced to sell flowers and other goods to tourists in Bangkok.

data.title: Minister targets companies linked to contamination
data.description: Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee on Tuesday vowed legal action against those responsible for a chemical leak from industrial waste that worsened flooding in Si Maha Phot district of Prachin Buri.

data.title: Unsit says flood funds 'sufficient'
data.description: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat on Tuesday assured that the government had sufficient funds to compensate flood victims, with payments already made to nearly 300,000 households.

data.title: Four held in industrial waste seizures
data.description: Authorities in Chon Buri have seized hundreds of tonnes of suspected industrial waste at two sites in the province and detained four people as part of a crackdown on the illegal storage and processing of industrial refuse.

data.title: Suchada faces asset scrutiny
data.description: Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap must explain suspected discrepancies in her asset declarations and will receive no legal assistance from the party, its secretary-general Chaichanok Chidchob said on Tuesday.

data.title: PM says text of censure motion hazy
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has criticised the wording of the opposition's no-confidence motion, suggesting it may be why the House speaker has yet to formally notify the government and saying the language may need to be polished to make it more "civilised".

data.title: Bipartisan US senators urge Trump to scrap Russian diesel deal
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Republican and Democratic US senators joined forces Tuesday to urge President Donald Trump to scrap his diesel deal with Russia, calling it a "betrayal" that would bankroll Moscow's war in Ukraine while doing little to ease soaring fuel prices.

data.title: Cornell suspends frat parties after alleged gang rape
data.description: NEW YORK - Cornell University on Tuesday suspended fraternities' parties and social events for the remaining academic year following outcry over an alleged gang rape at one of the elite college's all-male clubs.

data.title: Ex-gang leader sentenced to minimum 40 years for Tupac murder
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - Duane "Keffe D" Davis, the former Los Angeles gang leader who boasted for years of his involvement in the killing of rapper Tupac Shakur, only to deny it when he came to trial, was sentenced to a minimum 40 years in prison on Tuesday.

data.title: No lights, no friends: Cuban youth grapple with loneliness
data.description: HAVANA - With frequent power cuts transforming Havana into a ghost town, young Cubans are struggling to get their kicks, many resorting to games of dominoes with strangers to pass the time.

data.title: Pope Leo admitted to hospital for lung surgery
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV was admitted to hospital in Rome on Tuesday for surgery to remove a nodule on his lung, but cardinals said he appeared "very relaxed" about the operation.

data.title: AI could 'change the stakes' on bioweapons: UK spy chief
data.description: LONDON - The head of Britain's domestic spy agency warned Tuesday that artificial intelligence was affecting the security risks faced by the UK, and could "change the stakes" on bioweapons.

data.title: Tokenisation Meets AI: Global Finance Leaders Warn of Fragmentation Risks as Digital Markets Advance
data.description: Global leaders from the IMF, MAS, Euroclear, Swift, and Standard Chartered call for common standards, trusted central bank money, and strict safeguards as tokenisation and autonomous AI trading enter live markets

data.title: Netflix sees Thailand as a potential creative hub like South Korea
data.description: Netflix has invested about US$200 million in Thailand and urges rights protection, creative freedom and partnerships to take Thai content global.

data.title: Prosecutors drop most impeachment charges against Philippine VP Duterte
data.description: MANILA - A Philippine impeachment court on Tuesday granted the prosecutors' request to drop most of the charges against Vice President Sara Duterte at a trial that could still block her 2028 presidential bid.

data.title: Light-plane crash in Chon Buri injures pilot
data.description: CHON BURI - The Thai-German pilot was injured when a single-engine light aircraft crashed in Bang Lamung district on Tuesday.

data.title: Asean to discuss tackling transboundary haze ahead of November summit
data.description: MANILA/KUALA LUMPUR - ​Southeast Asian foreign ministers ‌will during a meeting next month seek to tackle the transboundary haze blanketing parts of the region, Asean chair the Philippines said on ​Tuesday.

data.title: Suvarnabhumi airport ends free parking for flooded motorists
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport has advised car owners with flooded homes who parked their vehicles there to remove them immediately, or start paying.

data.title: Top court accepts NBTC chief's appeal
data.description: The Supreme Administrative Court has agreed to rule on an appeal by National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck in a dispute over his eligibility to hold the post.

data.title: Justice minister unaware of details of Thaksin’s amnesty request
data.description: Justice Minister Rutthapon Naowarat said on Tuesday he was unaware of the details of former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra’s petition seeking an amnesty under the Peaceful Society Promotion Act, and would not be involved.

data.title: Hong Kong steps up Russia arrival checks after Siberian lab worker’s death
data.description: Hong Kong will step up health surveillance measures for arrivals after a laboratory worker at an anti-plague research institute in Russia died from pneumonia, but authorities have stressed the risk to residents remains low.
